evidence.locator: ALM for Power Apps, Power Automate, Microsoft Copilot Studio, and Dataverse
evidence.quote: Source control should be your source of truth for storing and collaborating on your components.

evidence.locator: ALM for Power Apps, Power Automate, Microsoft Copilot Studio, and Dataverse
evidence.quote: To use the Power Platform features and tools available to manage ALM, all environments that participate in ALM must include a Dataverse database.
Unmanaged solutions are used in development environments while you make changes to your application.
As an ALM best practice, managed solutions should be generated by exporting an unmanaged solution as managed and considered a build artifact.

When you delete a managed solution, the following data is lost: data stored in custom tables that are part of the managed solution and data stored in custom columns that are part of the managed solution on other tables that aren't part of the managed solution.

evidence.locator: Frequently asked questions / What do pipelines deploy?
evidence.quote: Pipelines deploy solutions as well as configuration for the target environment such as connections, connection references, and environment variables.

evidence.locator: Frequently asked questions / What do pipelines deploy?
evidence.quote: Pipelines, or solutions in general, don't contain data stored within Dataverse tables.
Connections and environment variables are provided upfront and validated before the deployment begins.

evidence.locator: Frequently asked questions / Can customization bypass a deployment stage such as QA?
evidence.quote: The same solution artifact must pass through pipeline stages in sequential order.

evidence.locator: Frequently asked questions / Can pipelines deploy to a different tenant?
evidence.quote: No. We recommend using Azure DevOps or GitHub for this scenario.

evidence.locator: Frequently asked questions / Are standalone licenses required to use pipelines?
evidence.quote: Licenses granting premium use rights are required for all managed environments.
Use plug-ins when a declarative process doesn't meet your requirement.
This interface exposes a single method called Execute.
A synchronous plug-in causes the data operation to wait until the code in the plug-in finishes.
Asynchronous plug-in execution is queued and runs after the data operation finishes.
Power Platform admin center data policies allow administrators to control access to these connectors in various ways to help reduce risk in your organization.
For the most extreme cases, the latency for full enforcement is 24 hours. In most cases, it's within an hour.
Microsoft permits the use of these icons in architectural diagrams, training materials, or documentation.
Don’t crop, flip, or rotate icons

evidence.locator: Key dates for the 2026 release wave 1
evidence.quote: These release plans describe functionality that may not have been released yet.
New Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and Dataverse capabilities will be published to the AI at Work roadmap beginning in September 2026.

claims.wording: Use source control as the source of truth for solution components.
The documented Power Platform ALM tooling requires participating environments to include a Dataverse database; this is not a claim that every Power Apps application requires Dataverse.
Use unmanaged solutions for development changes.
Treat the managed solution exported from development as a build artifact for downstream deployment.
Uninstalling managed solutions can lose data; it is not a generally safe rollback strategy.
Pipelines deploy solutions and target-environment configuration, including connection references and environment variables.
A solution deployment does not migrate Dataverse table records; plan data migration separately.
Resolve target connections and environment variables before deployment; this prevalidation does not prove business correctness.
The documented pipeline promotes the same solution artifact through sequential stages.
Built-in pipelines do not provide cross-tenant deployment in the cited documentation; assess another CI/CD path.
Validate environment licensing and actual entitlements; do not promise universally free pipeline usage.
Evaluate declarative options first; use plug-ins when the requirement warrants code.
The documented IPlugin interface exposes Execute; exact implementation signatures and registration steps need the linked SDK reference before writing code.
Synchronous plug-ins delay the data operation; keep work bounded and assess latency.
Asynchronous plug-ins run after the data operation, so they are not interchangeable with synchronous validation.
Data policies provide connector guardrails; this is not a guarantee against all data leakage or a substitute for application security.
Do not assume policy changes take effect instantly; validate enforcement in the target environment.
Official icons have stated permitted diagram, training, and documentation uses; this is not a general trademark or marketing license.
Preserve official icon orientation, shape, and proportions; do not use them as the a2swe logo.
A release-plan entry alone does not establish GA, tenant availability, or entitlement.
The inspected release-plan page directs new capability discovery to the AI at Work roadmap from September 2026; individual feature status still needs checking.
